title: Canonical finite smooth-trace coefficient presentations
statement: Let $P$ be the finite purity coefficient setting at a positive exponent and let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type morphism between finite-type schemes over its finite-field datum. Define primeTraceSetting at a positive exponent $r$ by replacing the coefficient extension with the bottom subfield. Define traceTwist as the specified shifted diagonal Tate line in intrinsic constant-ring coordinates. Define the pulled-unit, tensor-unit, and shift reassociation isomorphisms by the recorded pullback/site/tensor comparisons and ordinary unitors, and traceSourceIso as their composite identifying the actual smooth-trace source with traceTwist. For smooth $f$ of pure relative dimension $d$, traceOnTwist is the published normalized smoothTrace precomposed with compact support of traceSourceIso inverse. Define traceTwistExtensionIso by the specified finite root/Tate coefficient comparison. Define traceSupportModel by the sectionwise coefficient direct-image identification, and traceCompactComparison by the scalar extension of this identification, the canonical finite coefficient direct-image mate, and the inverse target identification on the same compactification. Define traceUnitExtensionIso by site/scalar comparison and multiplication-normalized unit extension. These are presentation maps only, with no universal trace-compatibility assertion. Constructions used: [def-pur-conventions], [def-pur-smooth-trace], [def-pur-smooth-purity-map], [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], [det-sp-reduction-exceptional], [det-sp-finite-general-ring], [def-sp-scalar-tensor-comparison-data], [det-sp-scalar-extension-functor], [def-sp-reduction-direct-image-comparison].

def traceCompactComparison (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (φ : (primeTraceSetting P r hr).Ring →+* P.Ring)
    (M : proEtaleDerivedCategory X (primeTraceSetting P r hr).Ring) :
    (scalarExtensionFunctor φ Y).obj ((smoothCompactSupport (primeTraceSetting P r hr) f).obj M) ⟶
      (smoothCompactSupport P f).obj ((scalarExtensionFunctor φ X).obj M)
